headline: Tydro contract discovery blocked by inaccessible documentation and block explorer; no deployed addresses enumerated

findings.text: Ink blockchain explorer (Blockscout at explorer.inkonchain.com) does not render searchable results via fetch; name-tag search capability unavailable.
Tydro protocol website (tydro.com) fetched successfully but contains no deployed contracts listing; docs.tydro.com blocks fetch access.
No audit links recorded in protocol context; cannot extract contract scope from audit PDFs.
No GitHub repository recorded in protocol context; cannot access deployment artifacts or contract manifests.
Single chain (Ink); limited discovery sources available.

rationale.verdict: Cannot enumerate contract addresses. Tydro is a white-label Aave v3 instance on Ink chain; official documentation and block explorer are inaccessible or non-functional for address discovery. Without GitHub deployments or published address docs, specific contract addresses cannot be catalogued.

protocol_metadata.about: Tydro is a non-custodial lending protocol for onchain capital markets. Powered by Aave and built on Ink, it enables trustless borrowing, flexible collateral, and seamless coordination across the Ink ecosystem. As a white-label instance of Aave v3, Tydro supports assets including wETH, kBTC, USDG, USDT0, and GHO.
